title: 辨識可編輯的相容輸入框
summary: 相容讀取可依明確的編輯能力及單次選取驗證提供寫入，不再一律限制為唯讀。
highlights: 支援明確回報可寫入的 UIA 編輯欄位，以及通過原生游標驗證的企業微信來源。
貼上、剪下與替換前重新核對選字及來源；切換輸入位置後拒絕原選取的寫入。
缺乏可編輯證據的聊天訊息與相容來源仍維持唯讀，保留原有偏好與剪貼簿驗證。
usage: 正常結束舊版後啟動新版，保持選字相容模式開啟。在支援的輸入框選字後，診斷會顯示可編輯；在其他欄位操作後請重新選字。請先用可還原的草稿確認目前應用程式版本的行為。

en.title: Recognize editable compatibility sources
en.summary: Compatibility reads can authorize editing through explicit editability evidence bound to an individual selection.
highlights: Supports UIA edit controls that explicitly report writable values and verified native-caret sources in WeCom.
Revalidates selection and source before Paste, Cut and replacement, rejecting an old selection after the input location changes.
Messages and compatibility sources without editing evidence remain read-only, preserving preferences and clipboard validation.
en.usage: Quit the old build normally and start the new build with Selection compatibility enabled. Select text in a supported editor; diagnostics show Editable when verified. Select again after working in another field. Try a disposable draft first to confirm behavior in your application version.
